concerns.text: The plan retains **FR‑010** – *"Before any lexical or syntactic feature extraction, the system shall verify that at least one raw transcript is present… abort with error code 101"* – even though the Specification Amendments explicitly make raw transcripts optional and set lexical/syntactic columns to `null` when unavailable. Because the publicly available ADReSS dataset provides no raw transcripts, this abort condition will cause the pipeline to stop before the primary semantic‑coherence analysis can run, rendering the plan infeasible.
